environment.milp: HiGHS via scipy.optimize.milp, full triangle formulation
environment.limits: MILP 60 s (BLX 2.0's internal MILP attempt 30 s, 60 s when n > 62); DP runs: 300-900 s process timeouts
environment.note: Times are wall-clock on a shared VM and are not identical budgets across solvers; see benchmarks/README.md.
